d:
The official, uncensored, English language version of the digital release of Kemoshonen Vol. 2. Some new artists, some returning ones. Image #4 has the table of contents with the names of the artists who participated this time around. The stories of this volume has a winter them going on for most of them.

Like before, the digital release was originally a PDF, so they had to be converted. I know how to convert them better from the outset now though, so they should come out as high-resolution as they can.

Official Digital + uncensored version available (in multiple languages) for purchase here:

https://www.doujin.com.tw/books/info/69227

Also available on booth, but STILL CENSORED:

https://kemoshonen.booth.pm/items/8195426

Not every artist featured in the book has a tag at the time of writing, so apologies for the ones that go untagged.

EDIT 14/08/2026: Added the animated promo of the cover page to the end of the gallery (as to not mess up the page ordering).
